title: "The covariate file"

::: callout-important
## Need further help?

Please use the relevant [Teams channel](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/channel/19%3A32f3d71d53fb4a78ae8ef1e1f98d5da1%40thread.tacv2/Using%20Phenotypic%20data?groupId=ef823ab8-2aa6-4001-83c0-f35ae8b2bfbc&tenantId=54475f80-1baa-4ea9-9185-c0de5cc603fe), if you have additional questions/problems relating to phenotypic data in p471.
:::

Everyone working in p471 gets access to a set of standard covariate variables that are derived by the PsychGen data management team based on data from the Birth Registry of Norway (MFR) and Statistics Norway (SSB).

Please note that you are not obliged to use any/all of these covariates in analyses; nor are they particularly recommended – this depends on your analytic question and is up to you as a researcher. However, if you wish to include e.g., education/income covariates and are not opinionated about how these should be operationalised, we recommend using those in the covariate file for consistency and to allow us to restrict access to sensitive data sources to only those with a clear analytic need.

The covariate file (v4) contains the following variables:

| **Variable name** | **Source** | **Category** | **Description** |
|---|---|---|---|
| year_birth | MFR (via MoBa) | Demographic | Year of birth |
| sex_birth | MFR | Demographic | Sex, prioritising sex recorded in birth registry (KJONN_MFR) |
| parity | MFR (via MoBa) | Demographic | Number of previous deliveries (0-4+) |
| mothers_age | MFR (via MoBa) | Demographic | Mother's age at child's birth (winsorized) |
| mother_age_first_child | MFR | Demographic | Mother's age, first child (winsorized) |
| number_children_mother | MFR | Demographic | Total number of children recorded (updated 2025), mother (winsorized) |
| fathers_age | MFR (via MoBa) | Demographic | Father's age at child's birth (winsorized) |
| father_age_first_child | MFR | Demographic | Father's age, first child (winsorized) |
| number_children_father | MFR | Demographic | Total number of children recorded (updated 2025), father (winsorized) |
| nus_simplified_code_m | SSB | Education | Mothers' educational attainment at child year of birth: NUS codes (1-digit) |
| edu_group_m | SSB | Education | Mothers' educational attainment at child year of birth: group (4-level) |
| isced_simplified_code_m | SSB | Education | Mothers' educational attainment at child year of birth: ISCED 2011 codes (1-digit) |
| isced_simplified_code_description_m | SSB | Education | Mothers' educational attainment at child year of birth: ISCED 2011 codes (description) |
| years_edu_m | SSB | Education | Mothers' educational attainment at child year of birth: minimum years in education |
| nus_simplified_code_f | SSB | Education | Fathers' educational attainment at child year of birth: NUS codes (1-digit) |
| edu_group_f | SSB | Education | Fathers' educational attainment at child year of birth: group (4-level) |
| isced_simplified_code_f | SSB | Education | Fathers' educational attainment at child year of birth: ISCED 2011 codes (1-digit) |
| isced_simplified_code_description_f | SSB | Education | Fathers' educational attainment at child year of birth: ISCED 2011 codes (description) |
| years_edu_f | SSB | Education | Fathers' educational attainment at child year of birth: minimum years in education |
| income_deciles_win | SSB | Income | Average parental income after tax at child year of birth (winsorized) |
